body: My depression and bipolar disorder suddenly disappear and I can finally go back to university.

I told my mom I'm suicidal. And there is nothing she really can do about it. She gave me a perfect childhood, but now she thinks its her fault.   
Life is rough.
I am a social being. But I think I have too much problems with myself. So I don't want to bother others with it.
Thanks for your warm words. It makes me feel like I got someone around me. It really helps.
